_about: Hand review of the grammar drafts, keyed by form|group (the draft's group). Fields replace Claude's; "exclude" drops a pattern; "mergeInto" overrides the family (a key, or null to keep it on its own).

-다면|condition._why: hypothetical 'if it were' — learners should tell it apart from -(으)면

-던 N|modifiers._why: recalling the past: its own point at levels 3-4
